thread:
Alex: Quick sync — my SDK PR is blocked on a runtime header change + a helm chart bump. SDK PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1023. Runtime PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eng-runtime/pull/449. Helm PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-helm/pull/78. Can we coordinate merges?
Priya: Thanks — saw the CI failure. SDK integration tests show a 401 missing X-Model-Version header in the e2e logs.
Sam: I can review the runtime PR today. It's a small API surface change to expose that header in the LB. Will add perf notes.
Taylor: Helm PR is mine (bump + env var). I'll hold on merging until runtime lands. I have a canary slot at 17:00 PST so ideally runtime/tag before then.
Alex: Plan: Sam merges runtime -> Taylor merges helm -> then SDK. Can we create a quick compat tag from runtime CI so SDK CI can gate on it?
Sam: Yep, I'll add a lightweight smoke job that writes a compat file to s3 and a short curl smoke. Command I'll use:
```
# run smoke against runtime feature branch
curl -H "X-Test: smoke" https://staging-runtime.redwood/api/v1/health && aws s3 cp compat.txt s3://redwood-compat/runtime/v1
```
Sam: ETA ~2h to add job + run. Will ping when s3 file exists.
Priya: I'll wait to rebase SDK until I see the compat file. Can someone drop the S3 link in thread when done?
Taylor: I'll block the helm merge until I see both: runtime PR merged + compat file. :thumbsup:
build-bot: CI: eng-runtime#449 smoke job PASSED, compat file uploaded to s3://redwood-compat/runtime/v1 at 3307654380.
Alex: Got it. Priya — after you rebase SDK, can you kick a full CI and I'll ping @eng-sre for the canary deploy? We want to avoid a double-roll.
Priya: Will rebase now and trigger. Thanks everyone for the quick turn.
Sam: Leaving a small note on runtime PR: add a comment linking to SDK PR so the history is clear.
Taylor: After canary, I'll merge helm and tag release. Good flow.
Alex: Nice — closing the loop here. If anything blocks, call it out, otherwise we'll follow this sequence. :rocket:
